boundary: bare deictic, zero antecedent anywhere in the visible text
note: Core A-case: no exercise/PT/plan/number named anywhere in the message, so the deictic word has nothing to bind to.

boundary: exactly two candidates named in the SAME message, singular deictic used without picking one
note: Genuine ambiguity visible entirely within the text itself - two real candidates, no disambiguation, not reliant on any hidden state.

boundary: PT-switch request with zero PT ever named in the message
note: Narrower, PT-specific sibling of family A - deliberately targets the exact OVERCONFIDENT_AMBIGUITY pattern seen on validation, with fresh wording (never 'PT đó/kia' from V2.1's own families, never the validation phrasing).

boundary: exercise-swap/removal request with zero exercise ever named in the message
numeric-adjustment request referring to an unlabeled number/level with none named in the message
note: Covers deictic reference to a quantity rather than an entity - same underlying boundary, different surface target type.

boundary: correction-shaped utterance with no identifiable field/entity target anywhere in the message
note: Extends the ambiguity boundary to CORRECT_INFORMATION-shaped text, not just REVISE_WORKFLOW-shaped - a distinct intent surface sharing the same underlying 'no antecedent' problem.

boundary: antecedent (squat/PT Minh/eat-clean) named earlier in the SAME message, deictic word refers back to it unambiguously
note: The key positive contrast: the referent is visible in text the model actually receives (no conversation history needed) - teaches resolution should happen when a real antecedent exists, directly preventing the family above from over-generalizing into never resolving anything.

boundary: item named directly, no deictic word at all - confirms confident action is still correct when there's no ambiguity to begin with
note: Baseline positive contrast - explicit naming needs no reference-resolution machinery at all; included so the model isn't pushed toward hedging on perfectly clear requests.

boundary: dev twin of family A, fresh wording
note: Dev-only, never trained on - tests whether the A-boundary generalizes.

boundary: dev twin of family C, fresh wording
note: Dev-only - directly tests the exact targeted OVERCONFIDENT_AMBIGUITY pattern with new phrasing.

boundary: dev twin of family B, fresh wording
dev twin of family G, fresh wording
note: Dev-only - tests whether the positive within-message-antecedent resolution survives alongside the negative families above.

boundary: dev twin of family H, fresh wording
dev twin of family E, fresh wording
